name: micle-berry
effect: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item, and its next used move has 1.2× its normal accuracy.
shortEffect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost accuracy of next move by 20%. (Gen IV: Perfect accuracy)

flavorTextEntries.text: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it raises the accuracy of a move just once in a pinch.
If held by a Pokémon, it raises the accuracy of a move just once in a pinch.
A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, its accuracy will increase just once when it’s in a pinch.
